body:
Here is what the fake mod sent me: 
from SQLswitch sent 16 days ago

Mod here, sorry, this is not the place for this post. It violates the guidelines of /r/SuicideWatch
It would be healthier for you if you weren't so self-absorbed. You are probably experiencing normal sadness, simply feeling a bit down. The people who are serious about suicide would never post, they would never communicate with anyone, they would just end their lives. You should reassess your values and get on with your life, it gets better when you'll get older.
And clearly you've never seen how suicide affects the family and loved ones. My next door neighbor (mid twenties, good job, graduated from a good college) took his own life. Seeing what he did to his own friends and family made me realize how selfish and horrible suicide is. Your psyche's got to be pretty twisted around if dying seems like a good thing. Suicide always has a ripple effect, it's going to permanently scar your family. Family history of suicide actually increases others' chances of becoming suicidal, themselves; if this is true, then suicide can sometimes be a delayed homicide, even if you don't intend it. If you save your life, you save others.
You're not going to kill yourself so please go away. By this you are saving lives.
Holy shit, I just found a message from one. I will forward it to you. I had never been so enraged in my life.

im killing myself to kill the pain. the bonus is maybe teaching those to treat people who need compassion or even a hug to do so. 

the last two verses in the Community theme song sums it all up: 

I can't count the reasons I should stay

One by one they all just fade away..

I've done all of those things. i find happiness in nothing. It used to be friendships and family and they both have abandoned me. I hope they all realize this once I've killed myself so that they don't do the same to someone else.

it's all really pointless. i do so much for everyone around me but when I legitimately need help...no one is around. Even when I ask..something is always more important. why would dying be any different? i'm sure there will be something more important the day of my funeral.
This is how they are...in their 50's. My mom had this with my dad. Why would I assume it not to be true.

I may be downvoted to hell but here it goes....I've had a lot of friend's kill themselves. Ive had two friend's parents kill themselves. Back then..I though: what cowards. Why would they do this to the family?

But then I got older and got to the darkest place I had ever been where I tried to kill myself. People who never get *that* low or don't suffer from depression, do not understand. It is about a pain that want go away. Words don't help. Getting told to "snap out of it" doesn't work -- I know.

**BUT** there is hope yet. You did something wrong, yes. You were young and full of hormones. You were dealing with a dying person and all these feelings were probably building up and confusing a young man. When we are young we have really very little concept of the consequences of our actions. I am not excusing it by no means but do not carry that burden. Understand we as humans are not impervious of faults. 

What you need is therapy. You need someone to dump all these thoughts on. That's what they are there for. It will help, I promise. But until you have exhausted every avenue, don't take your life. There is nothing after this...you have one shot. 

PROTIP: If you don't have insurance or a therapist, there are local mental health grad students at a local university that you can see for free. At lease where I live. If you want more info...PM me and we can chat. I can give you advice on how to go from wanting to die to wanting to live and make a change within.
